project: Duke Nukem: Time to Kill Recompiled
approach: Static recompilation of the PS1 executable and overlays; faithful Vanilla mode plus an optional Modernized profile
notes: Native Linux build of the USA disc (bring your own; PAL SLES-01515 does not work). Vanilla keeps the original play. Modernized adds camera-relative WASD, independent mouse aim, an optional first-person view, high refresh rates without faster simulation, widescreen and higher resolution, and EDuke32-style inventory and cheats. Controller support and a Windows build are next.
